title: PSR normalized signal record
description: Normalization target for every signal in the Kiro Fit Product Signal Repository. Extends the base schema in psr.md with the provenance, traceability and theme fields required by RFC-0001 §5.1 amendments.

signal_id.description: Deterministic UUIDv5 of source_ref under a fixed namespace, so re-running intake is idempotent.

class.description: One of the six signal classes in psr.md.

source.description: System or channel the signal came from, e.g. zendesk, github, sentry, ab_test, okr, social_reddit.

source_ref.description: Native identifier in the source system (ZD-10412, GH-381, EXP-2026-011, PC-001). A '#n' suffix disambiguates multi-theme records. This is the traceability anchor back to the raw file.

raw_content.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim source text, truncated. The unabridged content stays in the class folder (Signal Intake layer).

theme.description: Controlled-vocabulary theme assigned by the intake classifier. Themes are the clustering key for the Signal Index.

feature_area.description: Product surface, aligned to the repository layout (e.g. exercise/planning maps to ui/src/features/exercise).

cluster.description: Opportunity cluster the theme belongs to (see signal-index/clusters.json).

customer_tier.description: Highest-value customer tier attached to this individual signal. Feeds the customer_tier scoring factor.

created_at.description: When the signal was raised in its source system, not when it was ingested.

provenance_tier.description: Provenance tier per RFC-0001 §5.1. Ambient signals are never actioned alone.

code_refs.description: Paths (optionally path:symbol) in src/ that the signal implicates. Forward half of bidirectional traceability.

metrics.description: Source-specific quantitative payload preserved from intake (votes, csat, events, mrr_lost_usd, lift_pct, contract_value_usd_annual, ...).

weight.description: Computed by the Signal Scoring Engine, never entered by hand. Equals the theme weight tempered by this signal's own recency.

linked_signals.description: Corroborating signals from other classes on the same theme. Presence of cross-class links is what earns the corroboration multiplier.

status.description: raw = ingested only; processed = normalized and scored; mapped = has a backlog item or in-flight change; shipped = delivered; rejected = has a record in rejections.jsonl.
